The best time to undertake a restoration in Burwood is during the milder months of spring or autumn, when temperatures range between 10°C and 25°C, providing ideal conditions for paint application and mechanical work.

Humidity levels in Burwood can spike during summer, leading to issues like paint bubbling or slower drying times. By scheduling restorations during transitional seasons, you minimise these risks and ensure that materials perform optimally, resulting in a durable finish that lasts.

blogPosts.title: Preparing Your Car for Summer Heat in Burwood: Essential Tips
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn how to protect your vehicle from Burwood's summer heat with advice from AE Automotive on maintenance, repairs, and preventive care.
body: Summer in Burwood brings intense heat and UV radiation that can take a toll on your car's exterior and interior. At AE Automotive, we recommend proactive preparation to keep your vehicle in top condition. Start with a thorough inspection at our Burwood workshop, focusing on paint condition, tyre pressure, and cooling systems to prevent breakdowns during the hot months.

Paint protection is vital in Burwood's sunny climate, as UV rays can cause fading and oxidation. Consider a professional clear coat or ceramic coating from AE Automotive to shield your paintwork. We also advise regular washing and waxing to remove contaminants like pollen and bird droppings, which are common in Burwood's leafy suburbs and can damage finishes if left untreated.

Tyres are another critical area, as heat increases the risk of blowouts. Check pressures regularly, as they can rise in hot weather, and ensure tread depth is sufficient for safe driving. AE Automotive in Burwood offers free tyre checks and alignments to help you stay safe on the road, especially during summer road trips to nearby coastal areas.

Interior care is equally important, as high temperatures can crack dashboards and fade upholstery. Use sunshades and park in shaded spots when possible in Burwood. Our team can advise on interior treatments, like UV protectants, to maintain your car's cabin condition. Don't forget the engine—ensure coolant levels are topped up and the system is flushed to handle the increased load.

For Burwood drivers, scheduling preventive maintenance before summer peaks can save time and money. AE Automotive provides comprehensive checks, including battery testing and air conditioning servicing, to ensure your car performs reliably in the heat. Our location at 24 McIntyre St is convenient for quick drop-offs, and we serve the inner eastern suburbs with prompt service.

In conclusion, preparing your car for Burwood's summer heat involves paint protection, tyre care, and routine maintenance.
